rules.title: kde-material-you-colors fights the shell: scheme resets to Material You Dark / screen flashes every second

fix.text: Stop and disable the legacy color service — it is not part of this port and fights the shell's scheme pipeline.
fix.warning: Disables a user service. This is the documented fix; the shell's own scheme engine replaces it.

fix.text: Confirm the apply-loop actually stopped.
Re-run the autostart step: it removes the service and leftover MaterialYou color files.

rules.title: Color variant falls back to Tonal Spot after every reboot/login

fix.text: Enable the automatic scheme hand-off: Nexus -> Colors -> Advanced Colors -> 'Automatic Color scheme' ON.
Update the shell — the reset-after-restart bug was fixed on dev (maintainer marked it fixed).

rules.title: Bluetooth adapter turns on then immediately off; nothing pairs

fix.text: This was a missing/misconfigured bluez stack, not a shell bug. Install the stack and enable the service.
fix.command: sudo pacman -Sy bluez bluez-utils && sudo systemctl enable --now bluetooth.service
fix.warning: Uses sudo; installs packages and enables a system service.

fix.text: If the KDE Bluetooth settings app also fails, it is a system/service problem — do not chase it through the shell config.

rules.title: Bar/taskbar thumbnails or launcher entries broken — desktop cache stale

fix.text: Rebuild the KDE application cache, then ask KWin to reconfigure.
Reconfigure KWin.
If the quickshell desktop file is missing (thumbnails/screencast interfaces registered through it), re-run the autostart step.

rules.title: Workspace pills/tracker not running (KWin effect enabled but not loaded)

fix.text: Run the repo's own checker; exit code 3 means enabled-but-not-loaded.
Rebuild/reinstall the effect via the updater, then log out and back in — KWin only loads effects at startup.
Verify the D-Bus service is introspectable after login.

rules.title: Gamescope games launch in half the screen (fullscreen broken)

fix.text: Update to latest dev — the fullscreen handling for gamescope-launched games was fixed after the report.
Per-session workaround from the thread: toggle 'Dodge windows' for the game window.
The thread's maintainer workaround edits the Shortcuts.qml file directly; it is overwritten by updates, so prefer updating.
fix.warning: Edits an installed shell file in place; updates overwrite or conflict with it.

rules.title: Launcher opens on the monitor with the fullscreen video; alt-tab stops responding

fix.text: Update to latest dev: multi-monitor fullscreen focus fixes landed the same day this was reported; the video-wallpaper root cause is tracked alongside it.
Check your current commit first.

rules.title: GPU widget shows roughly half the real usage (averaged across every DRM card)

fix.text: Verify per-card usage yourself — the old build averaged every card, so a 100% dGPU next to an idle iGPU showed ~50%.
fix.command: for f in /sys/class/drm/card*/device/gpu_busy_percent; do echo "$f: $(cat $f)"; done

fix.text: Update to latest dev: the per-card averaging bug was fixed after being reported.

rules.title: Darkly window decoration/theme fails to apply

fix.text: Apply the decoration directly through kwin config, then reconfigure.
fix.command: kwriteconfig6 --file kwinrc --group org.kde.kdecoration2 --key library org.kde.darkly && kwriteconfig6 --file kwinrc --group org.kde.kdecoration2 --key theme @darkly

fix.text: Reconfigure KWin.
